latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pilot-alert.

- Provides configurable alerting on event patterns with webhook and message delivery.
- Supports aggregation, deduplication, and escalation to on-call agents.
- Enables webhook delivery for external services (Slack, Discord, PagerDuty).
- Includes example workflows for critical error, threshold, and deduplication alerting.
- Requires pilot-protocol skill, pilotctl, jq, curl, and a running daemon.
